subject: OpenBank discovery — schedule technical deep-dive & capacity sizing
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Subject: OpenBank discovery — schedule technical deep-dive & capacity sizing

Hi Liam / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great to learn more about OpenBank's planned Conversational Banking pilot. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Recap (very high level):
  • Use case: conversational transaction search + fraud triage via chat widget on mobile/web.
  • Expected pilot scope: ~50k MAUs, peak concurrency estimate ~150–250 reqs/minute (you mentioned spikes around reports).
  • Data: PII flow limited to hashed identifiers; security questionnaire in progress.

- Proposed next meeting: Technical deep-dive + Dedicated Capacity Sizing (throughput & latency). This will be a joint call between your engineering team and our serving/runtime leads to align on workload shape and sizing.

- Suggested slots (all times UTC):
  1) Tue, 27 Apr — 10:00–11:00 UTC
  2) Wed, 28 Apr — 15:00–16:00 UTC

Please confirm which slot works or propose alternatives. For the sizing call we'll ask for:
  - A short sample traffic profile (CSV) showing request rate by hour and 95th/99th percentile prompt lengths
  - Typical prompt/response token counts and any streaming requirements
  - Latency targets (p90/p95 for end-to-end token generation) and availability needs

I've attached the call notes from today and a small sample CSV template you can fill out. If helpful, I can also loop in our capacity lead (Priyom) and product ops (Evelyn) on the scheduling thread.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +44 7700 900123

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 10:12 AM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great to learn more about OpenBank's planned Conversational Banking pilot.

Thanks Chloe — appreciated the clear recap. Both Priya and I are available for a deeper technical session. Preference for slot 1 (Tue, 27 Apr 10:00–11:00 UTC).

A couple of clarifications so the right folks join from our side:
- We'll include one of our backend engineers (Marcus Torrance) and our platform lead (Sara Iqbal).
- High-level traffic: our current pilot estimate is ~200 requests/minute average during peak windows with brief spikes to ~400 reqs/minute (10–15 minute bursts). Typical prompt length: 60–120 tokens; responses avg 120–300 tokens.
- Latency goal: p95 end-to-end <250ms for the chat flows; we understand this is aggressive and want sizing guidance and trade-offs (batching vs dedicated pools).

We'll attach a small CSV of our hourly traffic by next Monday. Please send a calendar invite and any pre-read checklist for the sizing call.

Best,
Liam

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Liam. I've tentatively booked Tue 27 Apr 10:00–11:00 UTC and created a calendar event (link below). Priyom, Evelyn — looping you both in to lead the sizing conversation and bring the capacity playbook.

Pre-call asks (so we can come prepared):
- Please upload the hourly traffic CSV to the calendar event or reply to this thread. Use the attached template if convenient.
- If you have a short sample of typical prompt/response pairs (anonymized), that helps us estimate tokenization and KV cache behavior.
- Security contact: please share the best email for your InfoSec lead; we'll send the SOC2 checklist ahead of the call.

Meeting link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/8b2f1d-openbank-sizing
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/4319

We'll plan to cover: workload shape, latency SLOs, quantization/precision trade-offs, canary rollout plan for Dedicated pool, and a draft mutual action plan.

Thanks — I'll convert the tentative booking to a confirmed invite once I see Marcus/Sara accept.

Subject: Confirmed — OpenBank sizing call (Tue 27 Apr 10:00 UTC) & pre-read checklist

Hi Liam / Priya — thanks for confirming slot 1. Meeting is confirmed for Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:00–11:00 UTC (invite sent). Quick pre-read and checklist so the call is high-impact: 

1) Attachments and uploads (please reply or drop in the calendar event):
   - Hourly traffic CSV (required) — columns: timestamp UTC, requests, avg_prompt_tokens, avg_response_tokens
   - 3–5 sample anonymized prompts/responses (plain text)
   - Any latency SLAs or internal SLO docs

2) What we'll bring from Redwood:
   - Capacity model (initial GPU pool sizing scenarios)
   - Suggested batching & caching config per workload shape
   - Canary rollout + fallback policy recommended for Dedicated pools

3) Call goals:
   - Agree target p95/p99 latency thresholds and acceptable tail behavior
   - Produce a first-pass Dedicated pool sizing recommendation and cost/latency trade-offs
   - Define immediate next steps and owners for the mutual action plan (HubSpot deal RB-GB-4319)

Attachments: dedicated-sizing-checklist.pdf

If you hit any problems uploading the CSV, reply here and I can accept via secure link. Looking forward to it.
